proposed_widenings.name: on_hit_trigger family for class_feature
proposed_widenings.justification: Brutal Strike fires on a weapon-attack hit (conditional on Reckless Attack), not as a discrete activated feature. The only ClassFeatureMechanics family is 'activation', which demands a use-count resource and an activationCost. Brutal Strike has neither — it is an unlimited, always-available on-hit rider. A parallel 'on_hit_trigger' family for class_feature records is needed, analogous to the existing mastery 'on_hit_trigger'.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If the chosen attack roll hits, the target takes an extra 1d10 damage of the same type dealt by the weapon or Unarmed Strike, and you can cause one Brutal Strike effect of your choice.

proposed_widenings.name: optional or unlimited UseCountResource
proposed_widenings.justification: ClassFeatureMechanicsHeader unconditionally requires a 'resource: UseCountResource'. Brutal Strike has no per-rest cap — it is available on every eligible attack. The surface needs either an optional resource field or an 'unlimited' variant of UseCountResource to represent always-on riders.
proposed_widenings.evidence: No usage limit is stated in the source text; the feature may be triggered on every qualifying Reckless Attack hit in a turn.

proposed_widenings.name: force_move effect in ClassFeatureEffect
proposed_widenings.justification: Forceful Blow pushes the target 15 ft. The v4 atom 'force_move' exists in the taxonomy but is not a member of the ClassFeatureEffect union (only grant_extra_action and heal_hp are). The surface needs to admit force_move here.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Forceful Blow: The target is pushed 15 feet straight away from you.

proposed_widenings.name: modify_speed effect in ClassFeatureEffect
proposed_widenings.justification: Hamstring Blow reduces the target's Speed by 15 ft until start of next turn. The v4 atom 'modify_speed' exists but is not a member of ClassFeatureEffect.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Hamstring Blow: The target's Speed is reduced by 15 feet until the start of your next turn.

proposed_widenings.name: damage (weapon-type) effect in ClassFeatureEffect
proposed_widenings.justification: Brutal Strike adds +1d10 damage of the same type as the weapon. The v4 'damage' atom exists, but ClassFeatureEffect has no damage variant. Encoding the extra-damage rider requires admitting a damage effect here.
proposed_widenings.evidence: the target takes an extra 1d10 damage of the same type dealt by the weapon or Unarmed Strike

proposed_widenings.name: choose_one_of effect composition
proposed_widenings.justification: Brutal Strike lets the barbarian pick exactly one of N effect options at resolution time (Forceful Blow or Hamstring Blow). The surface has no mechanism for 'choose one from a set of effects'. This is distinct from multi-phase sequences (which are ordered) and from parallel grants.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you can cause one Brutal Strike effect of your choice. You have the following effect options.

proposed_widenings.name: prerequisite_feature link (requires Reckless Attack)
proposed_widenings.justification: Brutal Strike is gated on using Reckless Attack this turn, creating a cross-feature dependency. The surface has no way to model 'this feature activates only when another named feature was also used this turn'.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If you use Reckless Attack, you can forgo any Advantage on one Strength-based attack roll of your choice on your turn.

proposed_widenings.name: self move without opportunity attacks post-hit rider
proposed_widenings.justification: Forceful Blow also grants the attacker movement (up to half Speed) toward the target without provoking Opportunity Attacks. This is an attacker-self movement effect triggered post-hit. The v4 atoms 'move' and 'deny_opportunity_attack' exist, but there is no surface shape expressing 'caster may move X toward target after hit without OA'.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You can then move up to half your Speed straight toward the target without provoking Opportunity Attacks.

notes: No dhall/json/trace produced — the unit cannot be encoded honestly. The primary blocker is structural: ClassFeatureMechanics has only the 'activation' family, which is semantically wrong for an on-hit trigger with no resource cap. All v4 atoms required (force_move, modify_speed, damage, deny_opportunity_attack, move) already exist in the taxonomy; the gaps are in the surface type system (ClassFeatureEffect union too narrow, no on_hit_trigger family for class features, no choose-one-of mechanism, no prerequisite link). Closest existing shape is mastery OnHitTriggerMechanics, but that is scoped to the mastery record kind.
